personal_repos.name: spoiler-tags
personal_repos.description: A chrome extension that hides any text in <spoiler></spoiler> tags behind a click-to-reveal element. Meant to be used with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini when getting assistance with certain problems.

personal_repos.name: semfind
personal_repos.description: semfind is a CLI tool that allows coding agents to easily search for files of any type (text, images, video, PDFs, etc) with just a single tool call. semfind outperforms current harnesses using tools like grep, find, ls, etc in terms of both time and token efficiency.

personal_repos.name: lora-bomb
personal_repos.description: We hide an encrypted executable in LoRA weights and train the model to extract and run it on command — without degrading performance or raising suspicion.
